title: HLC node ID hardcoded 0x01..0x01 in production path
description: new_with_ipfs() at server_stores.rs:68 hardcodes HlcClock::new([0x01u8; 8], now_ms). The HLC node ID is supposed to be a unique identifier per process/node so that simultaneous events on different nodes get distinct timestamps. With all nodes sharing [0x01;8], the tiebreaking property of HLC is defeated — concurrent entries from different nodes can get identical HLC timestamps, breaking the log's uniqueness invariant. → Fix: derive node ID from a hash of the operator key or generate randomly on startup.
